name: Sobek: 2 Players

categories.label: Sold sets (tiles x Scarabs)
categories.labelVi: Bộ đã bán (số tile x Scarab)
categories.hint: For each set sold: number of tiles x total Scarabs on those tiles; enter the sum over all sets.

categories.label: Deben + Pirogue token values (incl. corruption bonus)
categories.labelVi: Giá trị token Deben + Pirogue (gồm thưởng tham nhũng)
categories.hint: Sum of Deben tokens and point-valued Pirogue tokens; include Deben drawn for having least Corruption (1 + 1 per 3 less).

categories.label: Corruption points (tiebreaker, not added)
categories.hint: Tiles on Corruption board + end-of-game leftover hand tiles + Pirogue corruption values. Already converted to Deben tokens.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, players start a new game (no shared win).

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when a player has no valid action on their turn.

notes: family: set-collection. Unsold hand tiles go to Corruption (sets of 3+ still in the loser's hand are removed). The Corruption count is enter-only to document the Deben bonus; enter the bonus Deben in tokens.

sources.title: Sobek: 2 Players Rulebook
sources.section: End of the game; Corruption count; Final scoring (pp. 11-12)
